title: Sample Report
verdict: Owners chasing failed payments by hand are the strongest early demand.

prospects.name: Acme Gym
prospects.pain_signal: The owner asked how others handle failed membership payments.
prospects.evidence: A public post describes the workflow and its time cost.
prospects.why_fit: The product automates the reminder step.
prospects.why_now: The post is two weeks old.
prospects.source_title: How do you handle failed payments?
prospects.opener: Saw your question about failed-payment follow-up. Worth sending to whoever owns billing?
prospects.caution: Confirm the workflow is still active.

prospects.name: Клуб «Ритм»
prospects.pain_signal: Вакансия администратора описывает ручное напоминание об оплате абонементов.
prospects.opener: Увидели вашу вакансию — подскажите, кто отвечает за оплаты?

prospects.name: Beta Studio
prospects.evidence: Announcement on the studio's public page.
prospects.why_fit: More locations mean more billing work.

patterns.title: Manual follow-up
patterns.insight: Owners rely on spreadsheets after payments fail.

rejected.name: Other Gym Co
rejected.reason: The posting account looked like a bot.

outreach_plan.first_step: Contact the top prospect with one source-based question.
outreach_plan.follow_up: Share a mockup only after they confirm the pain.

limits: Potential customers inferred from public signals, not confirmed buyers.
